settings.description_override: A small flourish with a feeling all its own. The Bag Scarf adds movement and color to a familiar handle, with a soft drape that makes a simple knot feel considered. Choose the print that feels like you, then carry it your way.
settings.fact_detail: Thin hems, fluid folds and a gentle sheen let the printed pattern take the lead.

settings.heading: Details
settings.content: A lightweight printed scarf for styling around a bag handle. Each colorway has its own pattern and border details.

settings.heading: Care
settings.content: Spot-clean gently or use a professional cleaner. Store flat or loosely rolled, away from direct sunlight.

settings.heading: Shipping & delivery
settings.content: Please allow 10 days from your order to dispatch. Delivery time is additional and varies by destination. You will receive tracking details when your order ships. See our shipping policy for delivery information.

settings.heading: Returns
settings.content: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for unused items in their original packaging with tags attached. To arrange a return, contact customerservice@velantrafashion.com. See our return policy for full conditions.
